title: All of the listed features are great. Wide slots
text:
All of the listed features are great. Wide slots. All of the listed features are great. Wide slots, it toasts 4 slices at a time, it all sounds great! I was so excited about the retro look and it matched the kitchen perfectly.

Ready to give some toast a try and I didn't get to finish it. It started smelling like burning wire or plastic so I quickly unplugged it. I couldn't find the source of the burning smell. I will not use it again.

product_metadata.title: BELLA 14093 LINEA 2 Slice Toaster with Extra Wide Slot, Color Red
features: Extra wide slots fit a variety of breads including thick bagels and artisanal breads
6 setting shade control dial for precise browning every time
Blue illuminated Bagel, Reheat, Defrost and Cancel buttons for customized toasting
High lift provides easy access to smaller breads
description: With its sleek design and multiple functions, this 2-slice long-slot toaster will add versatility and life to your kitchen countertop. It is made of durable stainless steel and features extra-wide slots with self-centering guides that evenly toasts any size slice, even thick bagels and long artisanal breads. The high-lift lever, allows for easy retrieval of smaller breads. Cleanup is a breeze thanks to slide-out crumb tray and convenient cord storage,110 Volt

details.Special Feature: High Lift Carriage, Variable Browning Control
